m3-refinement2-margin-uncertainty.title: Refinement 2: main-effect estimation uncertainty into sigma-honesty + thin-class surfacing
m3-refinement2-margin-uncertainty.imperative: In src/physics/instrument_panel/replication.py add: (1) MarginRemovalUncertainty frozen dataclass (driver_se, class_se: float|None; class_id: object; class_support: float; thin: bool); (2) main_effect_margin_uncertainty(grid, supports, thresholds) computing SE-of-the-mean (std/sqrt(n), ddof=1, None if <2 backing cells) for each driver row and class column of the grid (pure arithmetic over already-present values -- no fitted interaction term), and flagging thin=True when a class's resolved support (reusing the existing _class_support helper) is below thresholds.min_support_n (i.e. REPLICATION_MIN_SUPPORT_N via the frozen set, or an injected thresholds.min_support_n for tests); (3) widen_sigma_for_margin_uncertainty(sigma, margin) = sqrt(sigma**2 + (driver_se or 0)**2 + (class_se or 0)**2), no-op when margin is None; (4) extend CoverageCheck with an optional margin: MarginRemovalUncertainty|None = None field (default preserves all 18 existing replication tests); (5) extend CoverageReport with thin_classes: frozenset[object] = frozenset() and wire out_of_sample_coverage to widen sigma per-check via widen_sigma_for_margin_uncertainty before build_predictive, and to accumulate check.margin.class_id into thin_classes when check.margin is not None and check.margin.thin. Add tests to test_replication_channel.py: (a) a coverage check with a thin main-effect estimate (nonzero driver_se/class_se) gets a WIDER predictive interval and correspondingly higher/less-overclaiming empirical coverage than the same check with margin=None at an understated stated sigma -- proving the widening is real, not cosmetic; (b) a thin class (support below min_support_n) is surfaced in CoverageReport.thin_classes, never silently dropped, while a well-supported class is not flagged. RED: write both tests first against the current module, observe failure -- manual attest c1. GREEN: implement until both pass alongside the full existing replication suite.
